detail.reason_if_over: one glTF primitive per material per section mesh: 20 section meshes are required by the crash split

detail.rule: same-direction coplanar area of different materials < 10 mm2

TurboTimberEvolution.datum: D0: wing-root leading-edge station x symmetry plane x CAD thrust-axis height
TurboTimberEvolution.pose: neutral body pose (no ground presentation offset or attitude)

aileron_left_hinge.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler)
aileron_left_hinge.driven_by: roll: right stick -> right aileron negative (up), left aileron positive (down); authored differential 0.7 (down travel = 0.7 x up travel)
aileron_left_hinge.sim_range_source: OpenRC Simulator: manual linear travel at an assumed measurement station (delivery spec r2, sec. 4)

aileron_right_hinge.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler)
aileron_right_hinge.driven_by: roll: right stick -> right aileron negative (up), left aileron positive (down); authored differential 0.7 (down travel = 0.7 x up travel)
aileron_right_hinge.sim_range_source: OpenRC Simulator: manual linear travel at an assumed measurement station (delivery spec r2, sec. 4)

elevator_hinge.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler)
elevator_hinge.driven_by: pitch: stick back (nose up) -> negative; single one-piece elevator joined by a torsion rod
elevator_hinge.sim_range_source: OpenRC Simulator: manual linear travel at an assumed measurement station (delivery spec r2, sec. 4)

flap_left_hinge.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler)

flap_right_hinge.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler)

gear_left_suspension.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler); cross-wire springs limit it
gear_left_suspension.driven_by: ground load (suspension); springs: cross cables with tension springs, see metadata

wheel_left_axle.driven_by: ground contact (rolling without slip, radius 58.0 mm)

gear_right_suspension.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler); cross-wire springs limit it
gear_right_suspension.driven_by: ground load (suspension); springs: cross cables with tension springs, see metadata

wheel_right_axle.driven_by: ground contact (rolling without slip, radius 58.0 mm)

rudder_hinge.positive: trailing edge to the pilot's right (nose right)
rudder_hinge.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler)
rudder_hinge.sim_range_source: OpenRC Simulator: manual linear travel at an assumed measurement station (delivery spec r2, sec. 4)

tailwheel_steer.positive: same sense as rudder (wheel trails to the right)
tailwheel_steer.range_source: authored approximation (no manufacturer manual available to the modeler)
tailwheel_steer.driven_by: coupled to rudder_hinge 1:1 (wire tip sits inside the rudder)

tailwheel_axle.driven_by: ground contact (rolling without slip, radius 14.0 mm)

propeller_spin.positive: normal tractor rotation: clockwise seen from behind (pilot view)

tailwheel_steer.expected: trailing wheel to the right (follows rudder)

wheel_left_axle.expected: top of tyre forward = forward roll

wheel_right_axle.expected: top of tyre forward = forward roll

tailwheel_axle.expected: top of tyre forward = forward roll

propeller_spin.expected: top blade to the right = clockwise seen from behind

clearance.method: Blender BVH triangle-triangle overlap of the moving meshes against their neighbours; pairs already touching at rest (hinge-line contacts) and moving faces buried in the static foam at rest (gear wire in its bracket) are ignored; tailwheel_steer is swept together with rudder_hinge (the wire is rudder-driven); envelope = widest interval around 0 with no new overlap
clearance.note: ranges are reported, not clamped: the GLB carries no limits, the simulator applies its own

silhouette_master_vs_game.rule: pass if under 1 % of the silhouette pixels differ by more than one pixel (about 1 mm); the wing seen edge-on from the front is the tightest case (0.3 mm chordal tessellation + <=0.25 mm decimation)
silhouette_master_vs_game.master: full-resolution master STL export of the same CAD parts without marking layers (stl_v17, CAD sidecar frame)

clean_copy_rebuild.detail: source/{inputs,scripts,stl_juego_r2} copied to an empty folder; exporta_r2.py produced byte-identical export/aircraft.glb, aircraft_demo.glb and _export_data.json

negative_tests.detail: source/verification_negative/negative_tests.json (valida_glb.py and verifica_r2.py both exit 1 on every broken copy; the unmodified file passes)

cad_rebuild.detail: retesela_r2.py needs the master BREP caches (not shipped); its output is shipped in source/stl_juego_r2
